items.title_cn: 自组装肽（PuraStat™）用于ERCP相关出血的管理与预防：一项多中心前瞻性队列研究
items.title_en: Use of the self-assembling peptide (PuraStat™) for the management and prevention of ERCP-related bleeding: a multicenter prospective cohort study.
items.abstract_cn: 背景：内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）仍是胰胆疾病的核心治疗手段，但伴随严重不良事件。由于解剖限制及患者相关危险因素，内镜下括约肌切开术或壶腹周围操作相关的出血可能难以控制。PuraStat™是一种透明自组装肽（SAP）水凝胶，可促进止血与愈合。目前关于SAP在ERCP相关出血中疗效的特定数据仍有限。方法：我们开展了一项多中心、前瞻性、观察性研究，纳入2022年1月至2025年12月期间连续进行的ERCP操作，其中SAP用于治疗ERCP相关出血（术中出血（IPB）或迟发性出血）以及高危患者括约肌切开术后预防迟发性出血的预防性应用。主要结局指标为即刻止血，次要结局指标包括技术成功率、30天再出血率及与SAP使用相关的不良事件。结果：共纳入138例患者。平均年龄51.3岁（标准差16.8），其中91例（65.9%）为女性，20.3%接受抗血栓治疗。ERCP的主要适应证为胆总管结石（77.5%），其次为胰胆恶性肿瘤（18.1%）。SAP主要用于治疗IPB（82.6%），但也用于治疗迟发性出血（10.9%）及预防性应用（6.5%）。出血严重程度为轻度者占68.2%，其余为中度出血。所有患者均实现技术成功。SAP在97.7%的活动性出血患者中实现即刻止血。7例患者（5.1%）发生30天再出血，5例患者（3.6%）出现其他不良事件，均为ERCP术后胰腺炎，无操作相关死亡报告。亚组分析显示，SAP作为一线或二线（补救）治疗时疗效相当，但在轻度（渗血）出血中的结局显著优于中重度出血。结论：在此真实世界队列中，SAP作为ERCP相关出血的止血剂在技术上可行且安全，止血效果良好。
items.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) remains a cornerstone therapeutic intervention for pancreatobiliary disease but is associated with serious adverse events. Bleeding related to endoscopic sphincterotomy or periampullary manipulation may be difficult to control because of anatomic constraints and patient-related risk factors. PuraStat™ is a transparent self-assembling peptide (SAP) hydrogel that promotes hemostasis and healing. Data specific to the efficacy of SAP in ERCP-related bleeding remains limited. METHODS: We performed a multicenter, prospective, observational study including consecutive ERCP procedures between January 2022 and December 2025 in which SAP was used to treat ERCP-related bleeding (intraprocedural bleeding (IPB) or delayed bleeding) and prophylactic application for prevention of delayed bleeding after sphincterotomy in high-risk patients. The primary outcome was immediate hemostasis, and secondary outcomes included technical success, 30-day rebleeding, and adverse events related to use of SAP. RESULTS: A total of 138 patients were included. The mean age was 51.3 years (SD 16.8), with 91 (65.9%) females and 20.3% on antithrombotic therapy. The main indication for ERCP was choledocholithiasis (77.5%), followed by pancreaticobiliary malignancy (18.1%). SAP was predominantly used to treat IPB (82.6%) but was also used for treating delayed bleeding (10.9%) and prophylactically (6.5%). The severity of bleeding was mild in 68.2%, while the remainder had moderate bleeding. Technical success was achieved in all patients. SAP achieved immediate hemostasis in 97.7% of patients with active bleeding. 30-day rebleeding occurred in 7 patients (5.1%), while other adverse events occurred in 5 patients (3.6%), all of whom had post-ERCP pancreatitis, with no reported procedure-related mortality. Subgroup analysis revealed equal efficacy when SAP was used as a primary or secondary (rescue) therapy but significantly improved outcomes when used for mild (oozing) bleeding compared to moderately severe bleeding. CONCLUSIONS: In this real-world cohort, SAP appeared to be a technically feasible and safe hemostatic agent for ERCP-related bleeding, with favorable hemostatic outcomes.
items.summary_cn: PuraStat™自组装肽水凝胶在ERCP相关出血中技术成功率达100%，即时止血率97.7%，30天再出血率5.1%，是一种安全可行的止血剂。

items.title_cn: 上消化道出血内镜前预后评分研究的实施与报告：方法学系统评价
items.title_en: Conduct and reporting of studies developing pre-endoscopic prognostic scores in upper gastrointestinal bleeding: a methodological systematic review.
items.abstract_cn: 目的：已有多种内镜前预后评分系统被提出用于上消化道出血（UGIB）患者风险分层。本研究旨在评估这些研究的方法学及报告质量。研究设计与设置：系统检索PubMed、Embase、Cochrane及ClinicalTrials.gov数据库，检索时间从建库至11月15日。结果：从6675条识别记录中，纳入41项研究，报告了43种不同的评分系统。多数研究为单中心（76%）和回顾性（63%），主要评估整体风险分层（80%），而非识别低风险或高风险组（分别为41%和39%）。患者纳入标准与结局指标存在显著异质性。三分之一的研究根据出血病因纳入患者，而15%的研究仅纳入肝硬化患者（无论出血来源）。多数研究分析单一结局，包括简单结局（56%）或复合结局（24%），20%的研究评估了多个结局，其中死亡率报告最为频繁。在33种新开发的评分系统中，建模主要采用逻辑回归，预测因子选择基于单变量显著关联（61%），而现代惩罚回归方法极少使用。仅33%的研究报告了校准指标，39%进行了内部验证，多数研究未记录缺失数据的处理方法（65%）。总体而言，93%的研究被归类为高偏倚风险，主要由于变量事件比不足（49%的模型<10）、预测因子选择方法不当以及验证过程有限。结论：本系统评价揭示了UGIB内镜前预后评分研究存在高度异质性及多种方法学与报告问题。通俗语言摘要：上消化道出血（UGIB）是一种常见的医疗急症。目前已开发多种临床评分系统，帮助医生评估不良结局风险，并决定哪些患者需要住院、紧急治疗或可安全进行门诊管理。我们系统回顾了开发或改良UGIB内镜前预后评分的研究。目的并非比较各评分系统的效能，而是评估其开发与报告方式。我们识别出41项研究，描述了43种不同的评分系统。研究发现研究人群、结局指标及方法学方法存在显著异质性。许多研究存在重要局限性，如方法不当或报告不完整。部分评分系统在高度选择性的患者人群中开发，可能无法反映急诊科实际患者情况。这些发现提示，许多现有UGIB预后评分系统采用欠佳的方法或报告实践开发。未来研究应遵循当前方法学与报告建议，以提高UGIB患者预后评分的可靠性、透明性及临床实用性。
items.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Several pre-endoscopic prognostic scores have been proposed to stratify risk in patients with upper gastrointestinal bleeding (UGIB). This study aimed to assess the methodology and the quality of reporting of these studies. STUDY DESIGN AND SETTING: A systematic review was conducted in PubMed, Embase, Cochrane, and ClinicalTrials.gov, from inception to November 15 RESULTS: From 6,675 identified records, 41 studies reporting 43 distinct scores were included. The majority of studies were single-center (76%) and retrospective (63%), assessing global risk stratification (80%) rather than identifying low- or high-risk groups (41% and 39%, respectively). Considerable heterogeneity was observed in both patient inclusion criteria and outcome measures. One-third of the studies included patients based on the etiology of the bleeding, while 15% included only cirrhotic patients regardless the bleeding source. Most studies analyzed a single outcome, either simple (56%) or composite (24%), whereas 20% assessed multiple outcomes, with mortality being the most frequently reported. Among the 33 newly developed scores, modeling primarily used logistic regression with predictor selection based on univariate significant associations (61%) and modern penalized regression methods were rarely employed. Only 33% reported calibration measures, 39% performed internal validation, and most did not document handling of missing data (65%). Overall, 93% of studies were classified as having a high risk of bias, mainly due to insufficient event-per-variable ratios (<10 in 49% of models), inappropriate predictor selection methods, and limited validation processes. CONCLUSION: This systematic review highlights large heterogeneity and multiple methodological and reporting issues in studies proposing pre-endoscopic prognostic scores for UGIB. PLAIN LANGUAGE SUMMARY: Upper gastrointestinal bleeding (UGIB) is a common medical emergency. Several clinical scores have been developed to help physicians assess the risk of poor outcomes and decide which patients require hospitalization, urgent treatment, or can be safely managed as outpatients. We systematically reviewed studies that developed or modified pre-endoscopic prognostic scores for UGIB. Our objective was not to compare how well the scores performed, but to evaluate how they were developed and reported. We identified 41 studies describing 43 different scores. We found substantial heterogeneity in study populations, outcomes, and methodological approaches. Many studies had important limitations such as inadequate methods or incomplete reporting. Some scores were developed in highly selected patient populations that may not reflect patients seen in the emergency department. These findings suggest that many existing UGIB prognostic scores were developed using suboptimal methods or reporting practices. Future studies should follow current methodological and reporting recommendations to improve the reliability, transparency, and clinical usefulness of prognostic scores for patients with UGIB.
items.summary_cn: 该系统性综述发现，上消化道出血内镜前预后评分的研究在方法学和报告质量上存在高度异质性和诸多缺陷，如多数为单中心回顾性研究、预测变量选择方法不当、内部验证不足，且93%的研究被判定为高偏倚风险。

items.title_cn: 基于探针的共聚焦激光显微内镜胃癌诊断培训系统的建立与评估：来自国家培训项目的证据
items.title_en: Establishment and Evaluation of a Probe-based Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy Training System for Gastric Cancerous Lesions Diagnosis: Evidence from a National Training Program.
items.abstract_cn: 引言：基于探针的共聚焦激光显微内镜（pCLE）的学习过程具有挑战性，目前尚缺乏标准化的培训方案。本研究的主要目的是建立并评估一套初步的pCLE培训体系。方法：本前瞻性诊断试验基于全国性培训项目开展。培训体系包括在线理论课程和为期两天的线下培训。所有患者均接受pCLE及放大内镜（ME）检查。评估并比较基线水平、pCLE受训者、pCLE专家及ME专家的诊断效能。主要结局指标为胃部癌性病变的诊断准确率、敏感性和特异性。采用线性回归分析探讨影响受训者诊断准确率的因素。结果：共纳入150处病变及127名内镜医师。与基线水平相比，pCLE受训者的所有诊断指标均显著改善（均P<0.001）。pCLE受训者的诊断准确率显著低于pCLE专家（P=0.036）。pCLE受训者与ME专家在准确率、敏感性和特异性方面无显著差异。pCLE专家的准确率（P=0.039）和特异性（P=0.022）显著高于ME专家。职称、医院等级、胃镜操作经验、ME操作经验及学历对pCLE受训者的诊断准确率无显著影响。结论：短期系统性pCLE培训显示出显著效果，且pCLE受训者的诊断效能与成熟的ME技术相当。pCLE可作为快速提升内镜医师（尤其是初学者）对胃部癌性病变诊断水平的有效方法。
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: The learning process for probe-based confocal laser endomicroscopy (pCLE) is challenging, and standardized training protocols are currently lacking. The main purpose of this study is to establish and evaluate a preliminary pCLE training system. METHODS: This prospective diagnostic trial was carried out based on the nationwide training program. The training system included online theoretical courses and a two-day offline training. All patients underwent pCLE and magnifying endoscopy (ME). The diagnostic performances of baseline levels, pCLE trainees, pCLE experts, and ME experts were evaluated and compared. The primary outcomes were the diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity of gastric cancerous lesions. Linear regression analysis was adopted to explore the influence factors on the accuracy of trainees. RESULTS: A total of 150 lesions and 127 endoscopists were enrolled. All diagnostic indicators for pCLE trainees exhibited significant improvement versus baseline levels (all P < 0.001). pCLE trainees exhibited significantly lower accuracy than pCLE experts (P = 0.036). There were no significant differences in accuracy, sensitivity and specificity between pCLE trainees and ME experts. pCLE experts showed significantly higher accuracy (P = 0.039) and specificity (P = 0.022) than ME experts. Professional title, hospital level, gastroscopy experience, ME experience, and educational degree exerted no significant influence on the accuracy of pCLE trainees. CONCLUSION: Short-term systematic pCLE training demonstrated significant efficacy, and the diagnostic performance of pCLE trainees was comparable to that of mature ME technology. pCLE can serve as an effective method to promptly enhance the diagnostic proficiency of endoscopists, especially novices, for gastric cancerous lesions.
items.summary_cn: 短期系统性pCLE培训显著提升了内镜医师对胃癌病变的诊断性能，培训后学员的诊断准确率与成熟的放大内镜专家相当，且不受职称、医院等级等因素影响。

items.title_cn: 结直肠内镜黏膜下剥离术后计划内镜随访中的肿瘤复发：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.title_en: Neoplastic recurrence after colorectal endoscopic submucosal dissection at scheduled endoscopic surveillance: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.abstract_cn: 背景：结直肠内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）后按计划监测间隔期的肿瘤复发风险及其与组织学风险特征的相关性尚不明确，导致ESD术后监测建议存在不确定性。我们开展了一项系统评价和荟萃分析，评估ESD术后1年、3年和5年的肿瘤复发率，并进行了亚组分析。方法：系统检索截至2025年10月的文献。纳入研究评估了在计划性监测结肠镜检查中，于术后1年、3年和5年时切除部位或其附近的肿瘤复发情况。同时收集相同时间间隔内异时性肿瘤病变的发生率。采用随机效应模型合并数据，并根据原发病变组织学（低级别或高级别异型增生，以及T1期癌）和切除质量（R0切除 vs. 非R0切除）进行亚组分析。结果：共10项研究、5306处病变符合纳入标准。合并R0切除率为82%（95%CI 79%-85%）。总体肿瘤复发率较低且随时间保持稳定：1年、3年和5年复发率分别为1.2%（95%CI 0.4%-2.6%）、1.4%（95%CI 1.0%-1.9%）和1.9%（95%CI 0.9%-3.1%）。恶性复发罕见（0.2%），且仅限于非治愈性切除或深部黏膜下浸润病例。异时性病变合并发生率为1.4%（95%CI 0.4%-3.0%）。有限的时间分层数据提示，异时性肿瘤在随访期间逐渐累积，而非ESD术后早期失败所致。结论：在长达5年的内镜监测期内，肿瘤复发罕见，尤其对于R0切除且组织学表现良好的患者。对于低风险患者，可考虑将监测间隔延长至5年，主要基于异时性病变风险增加的原因。
items.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Neoplastic recurrence risk at scheduled surveillance intervals after colorectal endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD), as well as its association with histologic risk features, is unclear, resulting in uncertainty for post-ESD surveillance recommendations. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of 1-, 3-, and 5-year post-ESD neoplastic recurrence with subgroup analyses. METHOD: A systematic search was performed up until October 2025. Eligible studies were assessed for neoplastic recurrence at or near the resection site at 1-, 3-, and 5-year scheduled surveillance colonoscopies. Rates of metachronous neoplastic lesions at the same time-intervals were also collected. Data were pooled using a random-effects model, and subgroup analyses were conducted for histology of the index lesion (low or high grade dysplasia, and T1 cancer) and resection quality (R0 vs. non-R0). RESULTS: 10 studies encompassing 5306 lesions met the inclusion criteria. The pooled R0 resection rate was 82% (95%CI 79%-85%). Overall neoplastic recurrence rates were low and stable over time: 1.2% (95%CI 0.4%-2.6%), 1.4% (95%CI 1.0%-1.9%), and 1.9% (95%CI 0.9%-3.1%) at 1, 3, and 5 years, respectively. Malignant recurrence was rare (0.2%) and confined to noncurative resections or deep submucosal invasion. The pooled rate of metachronous lesions was 1.4% (95%CI 0.4%-3.0%). Limited time-stratified data suggest progressive accrual of metachronous neoplasia during follow-up rather than early post-ESD failure. CONCLUSIONS: Neoplastic recurrence is rare up to the 5-year endoscopic surveillance, especially in those with R0 resection and favorable histology. In low risk patients, an extended surveillance interval of up to 5 years can be considered, mostly because of an increased risk of metachronous lesions.
items.summary_cn: 结直肠ESD术后1、3、5年肿瘤复发率低且稳定（分别为1.2%、1.4%、1.9%），恶性复发罕见（0.2%），主要见于非治愈性切除或深部黏膜下浸润；低风险患者可考虑将内镜监测间隔延长至5年。

items.title_cn: 十二指肠主乳头Dieulafoy病变致隐匿性上消化道出血一例
items.title_en: Dieulafoy's Lesion of the Major Duodenal Papilla Presenting as Obscure Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding: A Case Report.
items.abstract_cn: Dieulafoy病变是一种罕见的血管异常，可导致危及生命的消化道出血。虽然胃是最常受累部位，但十二指肠主乳头的受累极为罕见，且可能被常规前视内镜检查遗漏。我们报告一例接受利伐沙班治疗的患者因不明原因上消化道出血而表现为乳头状Dieulafoy病变的罕见病例。一名69岁女性，因深静脉血栓接受利伐沙班治疗，合并高血压及甲状腺功能减退症，表现为反复黑便及重度贫血（血红蛋白5.8-7.1 g/dL）。尽管进行了包括胶囊内镜、结肠镜及两次前视食管胃十二指肠镜在内的广泛评估，仍未发现出血源。持续性贫血及十二指肠降段新鲜血液提示壶腹周围出血源。随后侧视十二指肠镜在十二指肠主乳头处发现一个1×1 mm的活动性出血红斑病变，符合Dieulafoy病变。采用肾上腺素注射、双极热凝及止血夹放置的联合内镜治疗实现了完全止血。利伐沙班暂时停用，随访6个月期间未发生再出血或术后胰腺炎。本病例突显了当前视内镜检查无诊断性发现时，乳头状Dieulafoy病变的诊断挑战。当怀疑壶腹周围出血源时，早期侧视十二指肠镜检查至关重要，且联合内镜治疗即使在抗凝患者中也能提供持久的止血效果。
items.abstract_en: Dieulafoy's lesion is an uncommon vascular anomaly that can cause life-threatening gastrointestinal bleeding. While the stomach is the most frequently affected site, involvement of the major duodenal papilla is exceedingly rare and may escape detection with conventional forward-viewing endoscopy. We report a rare case of papillary Dieulafoy's lesion presenting as obscure upper gastrointestinal bleeding in a patient receiving rivaroxaban. A 69-year-old woman with deep vein thrombosis receiving rivaroxaban, hypertension, and hypothyroidism presented with recurrent melena and severe anemia (hemoglobin 5.8-7.1 g/dL). Despite extensive evaluation, including capsule endoscopy, colonoscopy, and two forward-viewing esophagogastroduodenoscopies, no bleeding source was identified. Persistent anemia and fresh blood in the second portion of the duodenum raised suspicion of a periampullary bleeding source. Side-viewing duodenoscopy subsequently identified a 1 × 1 mm erythematous lesion with active bleeding at the major duodenal papilla, consistent with a Dieulafoy's lesion. Combination endoscopic therapy with epinephrine injection, bipolar thermal coagulation, and hemoclip placement achieved complete hemostasis. Rivaroxaban was temporarily discontinued, and no recurrent bleeding or post-procedural pancreatitis occurred during 6 months of follow-up. This case highlights the diagnostic challenge of papillary Dieulafoy's lesions when conventional forward-viewing endoscopy is non-diagnostic. Early side-viewing duodenoscopy is essential when a periampullary bleeding source is suspected, and combination endoscopic therapy can provide durable hemostasis, even in anticoagulated patients.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告了罕见的主十二指肠乳头Dieulafoy病变表现为隐匿性上消化道出血，强调了在常规前视内镜无法诊断时，早期使用侧视十二指肠镜的重要性，并展示了联合内镜治疗（肾上腺素注射、双极热凝和止血夹）在抗凝患者中实现持久止血的有效性。

items.title_cn: POEM术后胃食管反流发生率随肌切开长度显著增加。
items.title_en: Objective GERD following POEM significantly increased by length of myotomy.
items.abstract_cn: 引言：胃食管反流病（GERD）是经口内镜下肌切开术（POEM）治疗贲门失弛缓症后已知的潜在后遗症。尽管其发生率已有充分文献记载，但危险因素尚未明确。本研究旨在通过内镜下食管炎发生率及无线pH监测，重点关注肌切开长度与术中腔内功能性管腔成像探针（EndoFLIP）使用，识别POEM术后客观GERD的预测因素。方法：我们评估了2017年3月至2024年12月期间在我院接受POEM的193例患者。纳入POEM术后至少6个月接受上消化道内镜（EGD）和/或无线pH监测的患者（n=98）。DeMeester评分>14.72或内镜证实的食管炎定义为客观GERD。采用多变量逻辑回归分析评估肌切开长度对POEM术后GERD发生率的校正效应。敏感性分析评估了按贲门失弛缓症及EndoFLIP分层的亚组，并处理了潜在的学习曲线效应。切点分析确定了最佳肌切开阈值。结果：在98例合格患者（50%为女性，平均年龄52.6岁）中，47例（48%）符合POEM术后客观GERD标准；14%存在糜烂性食管炎，32%在无内镜下食管炎的情况下Bravo pH监测阳性。多变量分析显示肌切开长度是POEM术后GERD的显著校正预测因素（OR 1.84，95% CI 1.17-2.89，p=0.009）。该关联在仅限于贲门失弛缓症患者（OR 1.98，p=0.024）以及纳入手术次数以校正学习曲线（OR 1.71，p=0.017）时仍保持稳健。切点分析确定6.5 cm为最佳肌切开长度，在FLIP测量亚组中具有更好的区分度（约登指数0.316 vs. 0.109）。结论：48%的患者发生POEM术后客观GERD。肌切开长度是术后反流的校正预测因素，最佳阈值为6.5 cm。在接受术中EndoFLIP引导肌切开时，肌切开长度与GERD风险之间的关联最为显著，提示在实时扩张性监测条件下，肌切开长度是一个可调控且最具临床操作性的危险因素。
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a known potential sequelae of per oral endoscopic myotomy (POEM) for achalasia. Though the incidence is well documented, the risk factors are far from settled. We aimed to identify predictors of objective post-POEM GERD using endoscopic incidence of esophagitis and wireless pH testing with attention to myotomy length and intraoperative endoluminal functional lumen imaging probe (EndoFLIP) use. METHODS: We evaluated 193 patients undergoing POEM at our institution between March 2017 and December 2024. Patients who underwent upper endoscopy (EGD) and/or wireless pH testing at least 6 months post-POEM were included (n = 98). A DeMeester score > 14.72 or documented esophagitis defined objective GERD. Multivariable logistic regression analysis investigated adjusted effects of myotomy length on the incidence of post-POEM GERD. Sensitivity analyses evaluated achalasia- and EndoFLIP-stratified subgroups and addressed potential learning curve effects. Cut-point analysis identified an optimal myotomy threshold. RESULTS: Of 98 eligible patients (50% female, mean age 52.6 years), 47 (48%) met criteria for objective post-POEM GERD; 14% had erosive esophagitis, while 32% had a positive pH Bravo study without endoscopic esophagitis. Multivariable analysis identified myotomy length as a significant adjusted predictor of post-POEM GERD (OR 1.84, 95% CI 1.17-2.89, p = 0.009). This association was robust when restricted to achalasia patients (OR 1.98, p = 0.024) and when procedure number was included to account for learning curve (OR 1.71, p = 0.017). Cut-point analysis identified 6.5 cm an optimal myotomy length, with better discrimination in the FLIP-measured subgroup (Youden index 0.316 vs. 0.109). CONCLUSION: Objective post-POEM GERD occurred in 48% of patients. Myotomy length was an adjusted predictor of post-operative reflux with an optimal threshold of 6.5 cm. The association between myotomy length and GERD risk was most pronounced when undergoing intraoperative EndoFLIP-guided myotomy, suggesting that myotomy length is a modifiable risk factor most clinically actionable in the setting of real-time distensibility monitoring.
items.summary_cn: POEM术后客观胃食管反流发生率为48%，肌切开长度是术后反流的独立预测因素，最佳切开口径阈值为6.5 cm，且在术中EndoFLIP引导下肌切开长度与反流风险的关联最为显著。

items.title_cn: BMSNet：边界引导的多尺度息肉分割网络
items.title_en: BMSNet: a boundary-guided multi-scale polyp segmentation network.
items.abstract_cn: 在结肠镜图像中实现精确的息肉分割对于计算机辅助诊断和早期结直肠癌筛查至关重要。然而，由于息肉大小、形状和纹理的巨大差异，以及息肉与周围黏膜之间边界模糊、对比度低，该任务仍具有挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了边界引导的多尺度息肉分割网络（BMSNet），一种用于精确息肉分割的边界引导多尺度网络。首先，采用基于官方发布预训练权重初始化的尺度感知调制与Transformer-T骨干网络，高效提取多层级特征。随后，引入边界预测模块，通过双向特征交互和基于可微Canny的辅助监督生成初步边界先验。基于生成的边界信息，我们设计了边界引导的特征增强模块以优化特征表示，该模块融合了频域增强、多尺度特征交互和边界引导调制。最后，引入特征融合单元逐步整合多尺度特征并生成最终分割预测。在五个基准数据集上的大量实验证明了所提方法的有效性。在ClinicDB、Kvasir、ColonDB、ETIS和CVC-300数据集上，BMSNet的Dice得分分别达到0.943、0.920、0.828、0.825和0.913。这些结果表明，在评估实验设置下，BMSNet以适中的计算复杂度实现了具有竞争力的分割性能。
items.abstract_en: Accurate polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images is essential for computer-aided diagnosis and early colorectal cancer screening. However, this task remains challenging due to large variations in polyp size, shape, and texture, as well as blurred boundaries and low contrast between polyps and surrounding mucosa. To address these challenges, we propose boundary-guided multi-scale polyp segmentation network (BMSNet), a boundary-guided multi-scale network for accurate polyp segmentation. First, an Scale-Aware Modulation Meets Transformer-T backbone initialized with officially released pretrained weights is adopted to extract multi-level features efficiently. Then, a boundary prediction module is introduced to generate preliminary boundary priors through bidirectional feature interaction and differentiable Canny-based auxiliary supervision. Based on the generated boundary information, we design a boundary-guided feature enhancement module to refine feature representations. This module combines frequency-domain enhancement, multi-scale feature interaction, and boundary-guided modulation. Finally, a feature fusion unit is introduced to progressively integrate multi-scale features and generate the final segmentation prediction. Extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. On ClinicDB, Kvasir, ColonDB, ETIS, and CVC-300, BMSNet achieves Dice scores of 0.943, 0.920, 0.828, 0.825, and 0.913, respectively. These results indicate that BMSNet achieves competitive segmentation performance with moderate computational complexity under the evaluated experimental setting.
items.summary_cn: BMSNet是一种基于边界引导的多尺度息肉分割网络，在五个基准数据集上实现了具有竞争力的分割性能（Dice得分最高达0.943），可用于结肠镜图像中息肉的准确分割。

items.title_en: Cannula for ERCP and endoscopic system
items.abstract_en: To provide a cannula that can be easily inserted into a common bile duct or a pancreatic duct via a major duodenal papilla, and an endoscopic system provided with such a cannula. A second camera of the cannula captures an image of the entrance of a common bile duct or a pancreatic duct in a state where the second camera is inserted from the opening of a major duodenal papilla. A transparent shield provides a cavity around the second camera and ensures a field of view of the second camera in a state where the transparent shield is inserted from the opening. The shield has a convex surface around the central axis of the field of view of the second camera. The portion having the convex surface has a uniform thickness. A guide wire is configured to advance within the field of view of the second camera.
items.abstract_cn: 【问题】提供一种能够经由十二指肠大乳头开口轻松插入胆总管或胰管的插管，以及配备该插管的内镜系统。【方案】插管的第二摄像头在从十二指肠大乳头开口插入的状态下，拍摄胆总管或胰管入口的图像。透明护罩在第二摄像头周围形成空腔，并在从开口插入的状态下确保第二摄像头的视野。护罩在第二摄像头视野的中心轴周围具有凸面且厚度均匀。导丝被配置为在第二摄像头的视野内前进。
items.summary_cn: 该专利在ERCP插管前端集成第二摄像头和透明凸面护罩，使术者可在直视下确认十二指肠大乳头内胆管/胰管开口位置，导丝在摄像头视野内实时可见。核心价值在于减少对术者经验的依赖，降低误插胰管导致的ERCP术后胰腺炎风险，同时减少X线辐射暴露。

items.title_cn: 内镜系统、学习装置、控制方法及程序
items.title_en: Endoscope system, learning device, method for controlling endoscope system, learning method, and program
items.abstract_en: Current endoscope systems for diagnosing gastroesophageal reflux disease rely heavily on subjective doctor judgment, lacking reproducibility and objectivity in evaluating the state of the lower esophageal sphincter. An endoscope system equipped with an endoscope, air insufflation device, and image processing device that synchronizes video images with esophageal pressure data to quantify the relaxation state of the lower esophageal sphincter, using an esophageal pressure sensor and image sensor to generate diagnostic support information. Provides objective and reproducible quantification of the lower esophageal sphincter state, enhancing diagnostic accuracy and reliability.
items.abstract_cn: 当前诊断胃食管反流病（GERD）的内镜系统高度依赖医生的主观判断，在评估食管下括约肌（LES）状态时缺乏可重复性和客观性。本发明提供一种内镜系统，同步内镜视频图像与食管压力传感器数据，通过图像处理装置量化LES松弛状态并生成诊断支持信息，提供客观可重复的LES功能量化评估，提升诊断准确性和可靠性。
items.summary_cn: 该专利将内镜视频与食管压力传感器数据同步，通过AI算法量化食管下括约肌（LES）松弛状态，生成客观可重复的诊断支持信息。旨在解决GERD内镜诊断长期依赖医生主观判断、缺乏可重复性标准的临床痛点，提升反流病诊断的客观性和可靠性。
